main_text.head: XXI. REPONSORIA HOLSATIAE DUCIS AD LEGATUM.
main_text.p: SCriptum vestrum cum adjunctis literis Serenissimi Navarrorum Regis &c. Domini & consanguinei nostri plurimum colendi: Nec non exemplum mandatorum, quae sua Regia Serenitas vobis ad nos perferenda dedit, accepimus. Uti vero sua Regia Serenitatis benevolentia, & concepta de nobis fiducia, pergrata & quam jucunda fuit, ita magnitudo rerum vobis commissarum, G que

page.notes: The initial S is a large decorated initial joined to "Criptum" (transcribed as SCriptum). Catchword "que" is printed at the lower right as "quę". The signature mark "G" appears at the foot; it is treated as a signature-like mark placed in the text block, marked here as a note. Some words are damaged at line ends (e.g. "vestrum", "perferenda") but readable.
